test_box3d_overlap_naive: test the box3d_overlap_naive function to compute exact 3D box intersection volume and IoU
test_box3d_overlap_sampling: test the box3d_overlap_sampling function to compute approximate 3D box IoU via point sampling
test_box_volume: test the box_volume function to compute the volume of a 3D box from its 8 corner vertices
test_box_planar_dir: test the box_planar_dir function to compute inward-pointing unit normals for each face of a 3D box
test_clip_tri_by_plane: test the clip_tri_by_plane function to clip a triangle face against a box plane and return clipped triangles
